newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share trade dips, several prices ease.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share trade dips, several prices ease.

text.p: The turnover on the Latvian bourse on Monday slipped with several leading shares also heading lower, the stock exchange said.
Total turnover came to 250,342 lats, down from Friday's 309,131 lats.
Leading share Unibanka was stable at 3.20 lats on turnover of 35,657 lats although this turnover was beaten on the official list by Riga Transport Fleet.
It traded 43,515 lats as it fell to 1.75 lats from two lats while Staburadze also dipped, easing to 2.85 lats from 2.95 lats on turnover of 10,573 lats.
On the secondary list, Daugavpils Chain led the turnover on trade of 77,857 lats but was unchanged at 2.15 lats.
Fish cannery Salacgriva slipped to 4.50 lats from 4.59 lats on activity of 40,477 lats but other shares showed far lower turnover.
The Rigas Raugs yeast plant turned over 10,605 lats as it fell to 3.54 lats from 4.16 lats and Kaija fish cannery fell to 1.90 lats from two lats on trade of 7,392 lats.
